test_set_access.details: Locked 20% test partition (1,215 utterances) was NEVER accessed for training, calibration, or candidate selection.

nested_cv_isolation.details: Thresholds and models were selected strictly via inner folds; evaluated strictly on outer held-out folds.

recording_group_integrity.details: Prompt-level recording IDs verified; no duplicate or paired microphone cross-fold contamination.
